sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Tan broad-brim pith helmet with layered tan bands, a small gold/dark front emblem and broad black chinstrap descending from a square cheek buckle beneath the jaw. Short dark tightly curled hair is visible at rear/temple, separate dark brows; no glasses and no clearly separate beard, tiny dark upper-lip band versus shading cannot be resolved. Khaki pointed-collar button shirt with shoulder boards, gold loops/buttons and red-brown board ends. Strong screen-right profile with serious closed-mouth gaze, shoulder-and-bust crop, light from upper screen left and full pale grey-green painted background. Preserve actual strap placement, visible outfit and painted canvas; fine emblem geometry, collar pins and individual hairs unresolved.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Dark green peaked military cap with brown band/strap and small gold crossed-blade/wreath-style front badge. Mostly covered short dark side hair, separate brows, no eyewear or distinct moustache/beard visible; older lined face, nearly frontal slight screen-left view and restrained closed-mouth smile. Green broad-lapel uniform, pale pointed shirt/light green tie, shoulder boards with small gold marks, tiny silver/white decoration at lower screen right. Bust crop/upper-left lighting/full pale grey-green painted background. Tiny badge interior and shoulder/decoration details cannot be reliably read; retain visible groups without identity-based additions.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Short close dark tightly curled hair with receding temples, separate brows, no eyewear or clearly distinct facial hair; same strong screen-right profile, serious closed mouth. Dark navy broad-lapel suit, cream pointed-collar shirt and slate blue-grey tie bearing multiple pale spot marks. Upper bust crop, upper-left light and full pale grey-green painted background. Tiny upper-lip dark pixels versus shading, hair strands and exact tie marks unresolved; do not invent facial hair, insignia or accessories.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Bald/receded crown with narrow dark side/rear hair, separate brows, no eyewear or distinct facial hair visible; older lined face, nearly frontal slight screen-left gaze and restrained closed-mouth smile. Tan beige broad-lapel suit with small round lapel pin at screen left, cream/white pointed shirt, medium brown tie and white folded pocket square in screen-left pocket. Upper bust crop/upper-left light/full pale grey-green painted background. Fine pin design, tie texture and individual side hairs unreadable; preserve visible outfit groups, no invented medals or headwear.
